items.prompt: What would prevent you from presenting this capstone as a fully calibrated live risk system?
items.modelAnswer: It uses a tiny synthetic empirical window, fixed simplified exposures and no demonstrated live valuation, data lineage, dependence/tail inference, regime validation, real costs/liquidity or operational controls. A transparent estimate and stress report is not a guaranteed loss bound or permission to trade.
